messages: Rin: Quick check small UX/a11y pass on the embeddings export modal. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/qwerty/embeds-export. Main issues: unclear CTA, missing SR text, and selection ambiguity. Jules: Agreed. Change CTA to 'Export selected vectors (.csv)' and add a secondary 'Export all results (up to 10,000)'. Also add a small 'schema' link explaining headers. Priya: Accessibility: add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for queued exports and a visually-hidden note before confirm: `Exports over 500 rows are queued; exports over 5000 require confirmation.`. Rin: For selection copy: use "Select all visible" vs "Select all results (up to 10k)" to avoid accidental huge exports. Show a persistent banner when "all results" selected: "You selected 4,300 results exports >500 will be queued." Jules: Microcopy: add tooltip on the csv checkbox: 'Include metadata (may increase file size)'. And include JSONL option in the format dropdown for large/structured exports. Priya: Keyboard: space toggles selection, shift+click range, enter confirms export. Ensure focus returns to export button after modal closes. Add `?` help for shortcuts. design-bot: Note: PR #599 opened with modal copy changes. Accessibility tests added but e2e export-large flaky. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/599 Rin: Action items: Jules update Figma copy + schema link (today), Priya add aria snippets and SR text (48h), I'll file backend ticket for queued export behavior. Jules: Done, will push updated frames and add a small annotation for the banner copy. Priya: I'll draft the live-region examples and the SR text snippets. Rin: Thanks all will review updated frames in tomorrow's sync.
